sermons.title: Sermon 2059 | The Miracles of Our Lord's Death

scripture.verse: "Jesus, when He had cried again with a loud voice, yielded up the ghost. And, behold, the veil of the temple was rent in two from the top to the bottom. And the earth did quake and the rocks rent; and the gra ves were opened. And many bodies of the saints which slept, arose and came out of the graves after His resurrection and went into the holy city and appeared unto many."

sermons.title: Sermon 2060 | The Messages of Our Lord's Love

scripture.verse: "Go your way, tell His disciples and Peter that He goes beforeyou into Galilee: there shall you see Him, as He said unto you."

Sermon 2062 | Shoes of Iron, and Strength Sufficient: A New Year's Promise

scripture.verse: "And of Asher he said, Let Asher be blessed with children; let him be acceptable to his brethren, and let him dip his foot in oil. Thy shoes shall be iron and brass; and as thy days, so shall thy strength be."

sermons.title: Sermon 2063 | The Filling of Empty Vessels

scripture.verse: "Even empty vessels; borrow not a few."

"The Lord appeared to Solomon the second time, as He had appeared unto him at Gibeon. And the Lord said unto him, I have heard your prayer and your supplication, that you have made before Me: I have hallowed this house, which you have built, to put My name there forever. And My eyes and My heart shall be there perpetually."

sermons.title: Sermon 2065 | Our Great Shepherd Finding the Sheep

scripture.verse: "Until he finds it. And when he has found it. And when he comes home."

sermons.title: Sermon 2067 | The Spirit and the Wind

scripture.verse: "The wind blows where it wishes and you hear the sound of it but cannot tell from where it comes and where it goes. So is everyone that is born of the Spirit."
